# Conversational Flows Studio

> Done-for-you 24/7 business assistant across phone, WhatsApp, and web, designed for clinics and appointment-based local businesses.

Conversational Flows Studio provides automated phone call answering, WhatsApp messaging, and website chat/voice assistance. It answers routine patient inquiries (timings, doctors, fees, clinic location), captures appointment requests, and routes them to staff for confirmation—with zero technical setup required by the business.

## Core Services

- **24/7 Telephone Reception**: Inbound voice answering on +91 7965481796. Handles after-hours calls, answers common clinic questions, and collects caller requests.
- **WhatsApp Appointment Booking**: 24/7 WhatsApp messaging assistant on +91 63023 92274. Captures preferred dates, doctors, and patient details for staff review.
- **Website Voice & Chat Widget**: Interactive browser assistant with real-time speech and text responses for visitors.
- **Human-in-the-Loop Confirmation**: The assistant records preferred appointment slots and logs requests for clinic staff to confirm, avoiding accidental overbooking.
- **Strict Guardrails**: Answers operational and logistical questions while strictly deferring symptoms, medical advice, and diagnoses to doctors. Directs emergencies to 108.

- [WhatsApp Appointment Booking Guide](https://conversationalaistudio.online/whatsapp-appointment-booking): Clinic workflow guide for WhatsApp appointment requests, FAQs, and staff confirmation process.

## Reference Demo (Aura Health Clinic)

Conversational Flows Studio features a live, clearly disclosed fictional reference clinic to demonstrate multi-channel capabilities:
- **Clinic Name**: Aura Health Clinic (Fictional demonstration)
- **Assistant Persona**: Mira
- **Specialties & Doctors**: Dr. Anika Rao (Family Medicine), Dr. Rohan Mehta (Child Health)
- **Consultation Hours**: Monday–Saturday, 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM and 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM IST
- **Consultation Fee**: ₹600
- **Location**: Illustrative suite in Hyderabad, Telangana, India

## Technical Architecture & Evaluation

- [Playground](https://conversationalaistudio.online/demo): Browser testing environment measuring speech-to-text (STT), language model first-token latency (TTFT), and text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis speed.
